preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Mix ingredients, except sulfur and Na2S x 9H2O, and adjust pH to 6.5
    with H2SO4. Sterilize by filtration under a N2 atmosphere. Steam sulfur for 3
    hr on each of 3 successive days. Neutralize Na2S x 9H2O as a 5% solution, and
    autoclave under a N2 atmosphere. Aseptically and anaerobically add sterile sulfur
    to the medium. Prior to inoculation, add the sterile Na2S x 9H2O solution, and
    readjust pH to 6.5, if necessary.
- step_number: 2
  action: ADJUST_PH
  description: Dissolve nitrilotriacetic acid and adjust pH to 6.5 with KOH solution.
    Then proceed to add minerals. Adjust final pH to 7.0.

- Microbial cultivation

preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Mix ingredients, except yeast extract, peptone, vitamins, sulfur and
    Na2S x 9H2O, and autoclave under a N2-CO2 (80:20) atmosphere. Separately autoclave
    yeast extract and peptone as 10% solutions and Na2S x 9H2O as a 5% solution under
    a N2 atmosphere. Steam sulfur for 3 hr on each of 3 successive days. Filter-sterilize
    NaHCO3 as an 8% solution and vitamin solution while gassing with N2. Aseptically
    and anaerobically add yeast extract, peptone, NaHCO3 and vitamin solutions, and
    sulfur to the medium under a N2-CO2 (80:20) atmosphere. Prior to inoculation,
    add the sterile Na2S x 9H2O solution, and adjust pH to 6.2-6.4 with sterile 1
    N H2SO4.

    yeast extract and peptone as 10% solutions and Na2S x 9H2O as a 5% solution under
    a N2 atmosphere. Steam sulfur for 3 hr on each of 3 successive days. Filter-sterilize

    and anaerobically add yeast extract, peptone, NaHCO3 and vitamin solutions, and
    sulfur to the medium under a N2-CO2 (80:20) atmosphere. Prior to inoculation,
    add the sterile Na2S x 9H2O solution, and adjust pH to 6.2-6.4 with sterile 1
    N H2SO4.'

preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Mix ingredients except NaHCO3, Trace vitamins, Na2S x 9H2O and cysteine
    x HCl x H2O, and autoclave under a N2-CO2 (80:20) atmosphere. Filter-sterilize
    NaHCO3 as an 8% solution and Trace vitamins while gassing with N2. Separately
    autoclave Na2S x 9H2O and cysteine x HCl x H2O as 5% solutions under a N2 atmosphere.
    Aseptically and anaerobically add NaHCO3 and Trace vitamins to the medium under
    a N2-CO2 (80:20) atmosphere. Prior to inoculation, add the sterile Na2S x 9H2O
    and cysteine x HCl x H2O solutions, and adjust pH to 6.8.
- step_number: 2
  action: ADJUST_PH
  description: Adjust pH to 7.0 with 1 N KOH.

preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Mix ingredients except NaHCO3, Trace vitamins, Na2S x 9H2O and cysteine
    x HCl x H2O, and autoclave under a N2-CO2 (80:20) atmosphere. Filter-sterilize
    NaHCO3 as an 8% solution and Trace vitamins while gassing with N2. Separately
    autoclave Na2S x 9H2O and cysteine x HCl x H2O as 5% solutions under a N2 atmosphere.
    Aseptically and anaerobically add NaHCO3 and Trace vitamins to the medium under
    a N2-CO2 (80:20) atmosphere. Prior to inoculation, add the sterile Na2S x 9H2O
    and cysteine x HCl x H2O solutions, and adjust pH to 6.8.

Filter-sterilize NaHCO3 as an 8% solution and Trace vitamins while gassing with N2. Separately autoclave Na2S x 9H2O and cysteine x HCl x H2O as 5% solutions under a N2 atmosphere. Aseptically and anaerobically add NaHCO3 and Trace vitamins to the medium under a N2-CO2 (80:20) atmosphere. Prior to inoculation, add the sterile Na2S x 9H2O and cysteine x HCl x H2O solutions, and adjust pH to 6.8.

claims.snippet: "Mix ingredients except NaHCO3, Trace vitamins, Na2S x 9H2O and cysteine x HCl x H2O, and autoclave under a N2-CO2 (80:20) atmosphere. Filter-sterilize NaHCO3 as an 8% solution and Trace vitamins while gassing with N2. Separately autoclave Na2S x 9H2O and cysteine x HCl x H2O as 5% solutions under a N2 atmosphere. Aseptically and anaerobically add NaHCO3 and Trace vitamins to the medium under a N2-CO2 (80:20) atmosphere. Prior to inoculation, add the sterile Na2S x 9H2O and cysteine x HCl x H2O solutions, and adjust pH to 6.8."

claims.new: Receiving-medium instructions (context only; not a stock-batch recipe): Mix ingredients, except yeast extract, peptone, vitamins, sulfur and Na2S・9H2O, and autoclave under a N2--CO2 (80:20) atmosphere. Separately autoclave yeast extract and peptone as 10% solutions and Na2S・9H2O as a 5% solution under a N2 atmosphere. Steam sulfur for 3 hr on each of 3 successive days. Filter--sterilize NaHCO3 as an 8% solution and vitamin solution while gassing with N2. Aseptically and anaerobically add yeast extract, peptone, NaHCO3 and vitamin solutions, and sulfur to the medium under a N2--CO2 (80:20) atmosphere. Prior to inoculation, add the sterile Na2S・9H2O solution, and adjust pH to 6.2--6.4 with sterile 1 N H2SO4.

claims.new: Receiving-medium instructions (context only; not a stock-batch recipe): Mix ingredients except NaHCO3, Trace vitamins, Na2S・9H2O and cysteine・HCl・H2O, and autoclave under a N2--CO2 (80:20) atmosphere. Filter--sterilize NaHCO3 as an 8% solution and Trace vitamins while gassing with N2. Separately autoclave Na2S・9H2O and cysteine・HCl・H2O as 5% solutions under a N2 atmosphere. Aseptically and anaerobically add NaHCO3 and Trace vitamins to the medium under a N2--CO2 (80:20) atmosphere. Prior to inoculation, add the sterile Na2S・9H2O and cysteine・HCl・H2O solutions, and adjust pH to 6.8.
